result:
Decision: **CONTINUE**. Round 182 is **M3**: the library rows get 4 px of space between them. I didn't touch any app source; `git status` in store was clean before and after.

**Round 181:** C passed it with real browser checks at both viewports and 0 bugs. Root published it as `f1782f8`, which matches C's verified end tree. So **M1 (round icon-only Play) is now მზადაა** in `backlog.json` and `feature-status.md`. The only blocked check is the fake-Bearer 403, because there is no backend in the cloud; it stays open evidence.

**Why M3 and not the regression round:** the last regression was 2026-10-24 and today is 2026-10-26, so it isn't due until tomorrow. No Critical, High or Medium finding is open, and the three decision files are unchanged (I re-hashed them). M3 is next in the visual stage.

**One thing for you to decide:** the spec's reason for M3 was "the serif name needs more air", but you dropped serif later. M3 itself was approved on its own line, so I kept it. I marked it vetoable in `feature-status.md`; a veto reverts one class. The spec also expected fewer visible rows. I measured in real Chromium on the published tree, and the visible count stays the same: 6 rows at 1440×900 and 3 at 1280×720.

**The round-182 task (`current-task.md`):**
- **Change:** one class added to the library list in `ArrangementLibrary.tsx`. Row height, padding and the hover/selected fills stay the same. Each row's highlight box stays the same size, and the 4 px gap isn't clickable.
- **Files A may change:** that component, `library-row-strings-ui.test.tsx` (one new test, LGS1), doc 149 (mark it Completed), and a new doc 150. Everything else is frozen, including the auth and purchase files, the routes and `root.tsx`. My targeted test run on the start tree: 17 files, 328/328 passing.
- **Tests:** LGS1 checks the class names only. Four deliberate code breaks (m304–m307) prove it fails when the gap is removed, enlarged, moved onto the rows, or replaced by taller rows.
- **C's browser checks:** the gaps measure 4 px, row heights are unchanged, and nothing outside the list moves. Scrolling and the arrow keys still keep the selected row in view. Click, double-click, Enter, drag onto a lane and preview (with real audio output) still work. Play is still 32×32, and the anonymous `/studio-lab` and sign-in protection checks still pass.
- **Ableton:** I consulted no source. This is a spacing change only, so no Ableton claim is made.

**C's and A's round-181 notes:**
- The press-state size wording is now a rule: size checks ignore the existing 0.98 press scale.
- Two small test-text issues in `transport-surface-ui.test.tsx` went to the deferred polish list, because round 182 doesn't own that file.
- The `aria-keyshortcuts` suggestion is recorded but not scheduled.
- The headless tooltip check went to the Tech Lead manual list.
- A's architecture note was "none". The frontend-architect checkpoint request is still unanswered; it doesn't block anything.

**Next:** the next planning (2026-10-27 or later) will be the regression round, now including M1 and M3. M4 (cookie banner) follows. The banner lives in `app/components/common/CookieConsent.tsx` and is mounted from the protected `app/root.tsx`, so that round needs a decision on changing a file shared with the Store.

Advisor: available, and consulted twice. Its fixes are applied:
- Mutations m306 and m307 now keep the gap, so they test the row checks.
- The scroll check now measures the wheel and the arrow keys separately.

I archived the old task as `tasks/round-181.md` (identical copy) and saved before-copies in `b-round-181/before/`.

Files are in `tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- `current-task.md`
- `b-round-181.md`
- `b-next.json`
- `backlog.json`
- `feature-status.md`
